'''Bonekrusher Infiltrator''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Landbreaker armed with melee weapons. Infiltrators are extremely agile and capable combatants who fight with two weapons at once. They are not to be trifled with.}}

==Overview==
An extremely agile variant of melee Bonekrushers, Bonekrusher Infiltrators are considered one of the most annoying common enemies, mainly due to their defensive ability; When they're not attacking, they can dodge ''all'' attacks directed to them, making them  basically invulnerable.

They attack with a dagger throw or four consecutive cuts, both dealing Physical damage, but also render them vulnerable as they cannot attack and dodge at the same time.
